audit_name: World Model Persistence Collapse Root-Cause Audit

discovered_root_causes.component: Synthetic Pretraining vs Real Data Distribution
discovered_root_causes.finding: Production model artifacts/world_model/best_model.pt was trained on 120 synthetic normal vectors drawn from N(0, 1) with synthetic sine drift. It never encountered real NetFlow dynamics.
discovered_root_causes.evidence: best_model manifest confirms 120 synthetic training samples with MAE ~0.02.

discovered_root_causes.finding: The model predicts S_hat_{t+k} = S_t + Delta_S_hat. The delta head was initialized to produce outputs of magnitude ~0.01-0.1. However, raw/improperly normalized real network state features have values up to 38,000 (and raw up to 3.6e9). Because Delta_S_hat << S_t, S_hat_{t+k} ~ S_t, locking the model into Persistence.
discovered_root_causes.evidence: Production model prediction differs from Persistence by only 0.0156 on 32,860 MAE.

discovered_root_causes.finding: Due to features spanning 18 orders of magnitude, linear autoregression covariance matrices had condition numbers > 10^16. When inverted, ridge regression produced singular matrix warnings and exploded to MAE > 4.3e7.
discovered_root_causes.evidence: Phase 11B Linear MAE was 43,713,804.0; pytest logs singular matrix warning.
